review_evidence: Complexitylib/Asymptotics/PolyBound.lean: defines PolyBound (pointwise domination by a Polynomial ℕ) and proves 10 theorems: const, id, add, mul, mono, max, eval, pow, bigO, exists_mul_pow_bound.

Complexitylib/Asymptotics/PolynomialComposition.lean: proves 2 theorems, BigO.polynomial_eval_comp and BigO.polynomial_composition_time, that give power-form big-O bounds for composed polynomial evaluations.
summary: Read both files in the unit completely (2 of 2). Both are Lean 4 modules with formal definitions and proved theorems about polynomial bounds and big-O asymptotics for natural-number functions. Both stay searchable; no exclusions.
